answer.text: This is a confirmed supplier defect on the TrailPeak 2-Person Tent (CMP-0001). First, get the batch code from the white label inside the tent bag. If it's ZB-2602, treat it as a known fault with no photos needed. Offer a replacement from a later batch or a full refund, book the return with reason "Faulty zip", and tag the ticket "Product fault" with a link to the KB article. If the batch code is different, follow the normal Warranty Policy.
assumptions: Assumed the tent is the TrailPeak 2-Person Tent (SKU CMP-0001).
I did not retrieve the normal Warranty Policy, so I can't give its steps for other batch codes.
